svg.title: Figure 6-1. PMHF: status of the evaluation against the targets (WP-H-05 §4, §6, §8)
svg.desc: Top: the inputs to the PMHF evaluation with their status from §6: method approved by the lead (PMHF plus a per-cause check of the biggest contributors, DQ-066), mission profile working values approved by the lead (15 years, 7,500 operating hours, ambient up to 85 degrees C; DQ-067), no part-level failure rates because there is no BOM (generic rates only, the harness box switches at the SN 29500-2 reference value), FMEDA qualitative at block level plus a generic-rate block FMEDA, PMHF per safety goal cannot be computed, and verification of the vehicle external measures AOU-01R, AOU-04R and AOU-05R not started. Bottom: for each row of the §8 results template (SG-01 and SG-03/SG-04 in two variants, with and without external measures; SG-02/SG-06, SG-05 and SG-07) the terms single-point plus residual, dual-point and PMHF are all to be determined, the target is below 100 FIT (10 to the minus 7 per hour) and the result is not yet computed. The expected dominant contributors of §5.1 and the external measures of §5 are listed per row.
svg.text: Figure 6-1 · PMHF against the targets: no value can be computed yet
Inputs to the evaluation (§6) and, per safety goal, the PMHF terms of §2.1 against the §4 target · every term is still TBD
A · Inputs to the evaluation (§6 status)
No BOM and no failure-rate data (§1; WP-H-02 UK-01/02)

DC-01 (IWDG1) is implemented since 2026-10-12, not verified: not credited in the PMHF or as DC until HIL fault-injection evidence exists. The §6 judgement is unchanged: no conclusion on meeting the target is possible today.
B · PMHF per safety goal (§8 template): terms of §2.1 against the §4 target
MCU core, SRAM wrong-data; flash multi-bit
AOU-01R: EPS torque limit and timeout · unverified
MCU hang/reset while engaged + siren path
MCU core, SRAM wrong-data; flash multi-bit
AOU-05R: PCM clamp and cancel · unverified
Relay stuck intercepting; relay driver short;
AOU-04R: PCS priority; not vs relay stuck · unverified

Target: < 10⁻⁷ /h (100 FIT) for ASIL B and C, a commonly used value to be verified against the licensed text (OI-4); ASIL D would be < 10 FIT and applies only if AOU-01/02 fail. The full budget is allocated to E-04 + E-05.
External measures count only in the effect analysis, never as DC; an unverified AoU turns its faults back into single-point faults, so both variants are reported (§5).

g.text: Amber text: vehicle-side AoU relied on, unverified
